message.content: {"note_claim": "Walmart is not closing stores on November 1st, has made no such announcement, and the claim has been debunked by fact-checkers.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "However, the claims are false, as Walmart has not announced any closure of its physical stores, and certainly not due to the lapse of SNAP benefits.", "reason": "The fact-check article directly states the rumor is false, that Walmart has not announced any store closures, and that there is no connection to SNAP benefits, substantiating the note's core claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Walmart is not closing stores on November 1st, has made no such announcement, and the claim has been debunked by fact-checkers.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: However, the claims are false, as Walmart has not announced any closure of its physical stores, and certainly not due to the lapse of SNAP benefits.
